newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia SIR20 rubber flat in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia SIR20 rubber flat in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in slow late trading on Wednesday, but fresh enquiries were seen keeping sentiment afloat, dealers said.
"Fresh enquiries from Europe and Singapore have kept sentiment afloat despite the overall slow trading," one dealer in south Sumatran city of Tanjung Pinang said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for November/December were at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 54.75-55.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang as well as at 54.75-55.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Dealers said SIR20 was last traded at 55.25 cents/lb fob Medan for November/December deliveries late last Friday and fob Padang at 54.75 cents/lb late on Monday.
High amoniac latex for export was last traded at 90 cents/kg fob Medan for October deliveries, down from 108 cents last week, dealers said.

Indonesia's largest latex and wholly-rubber products manufacturer, state-owned PT Perkebunan Nusantara III, said on Wednesday it expected to sharply expand production ahead of its 1998 listing on local bourses.
